thread:
elaine: quick thread to propose a lightweight playbook for closing postmortem actions faster and rotating IC responsibilities without dropping context. gist: short ticks, auto reminders, simple handoff checklist.

omar: big fan. PM actions often sit untriaged for weeks. can you sketch the flow?

elaine: sure, here's a compact flow i want to pilot: 
```
Day 0 - PM published: create GH issues for each action (label: postmortem-action, due: 14d) & set owner + backup
Day 2 - 20m triage: confirm owners, estimate, add "quick mitigation" field (1-2 lines)
Day 7 - heartbeat: bot posts status table to #incidents; owners must update issues by EOD
Day 14 - hard close target: either closed, moved to roadmap with product sign-off, or escalated with interim mitigation
Day 45 - recurrence check: automated scan for similar incidents; if >=2 occurrences, open recurring-review ticket
```
Plus: monthly IC rotation for backup pool with a 10m handover checklist embedded in the PM doc.

ryan: small ask: make sure each GH issue has a recurrence-risk tag (low/med/high) so we can prioritize.

sabrina: agree. also add service/product labels for dashboard filters. who owns the automation?

elaine: ops-bot can own the reminders; we need a small GH action + lambda to parse PM doc and create issues. jen may help with the GH action.

ops-bot: scheduled: create_pm_issues (next_run 1720507000)

omar: for the IC rotation: monthly roster but require a 10m documented handoff that includes open actions, current mitigations, and runbook links. when IC changes, owner backups should be re-confirmed.

ryan: we should add a minimal dashboard: open PM actions by age + % closed <=14d + recurring-incident count. that becomes our KPI for the pilot.

elaine: yes. metrics to track for pilot: % closed in 14d, avg age at close, number escalated to product.

sabrina: comms cadence: bot posts Day7 heartbeat to #incidents, Day14 closure summary to #exec-digest (one line + link), and if recurrence flagged, ping SRE leads. keeps noise low.

omar: implementation detail: GH issue template with fields: owner, backup, due_date, risk(low/med/high), quick_mitigation, service_label, pm_id. that makes automation simple.

ryan: one more: add a TTL in the PM doc header: auto-archive PM in 90 days if no recurrence and all actions closed. helps reduce doc clutter.

elaine: plan: i'll draft the GH issue template + one-pager and open an ops PR by Wed. pilot two recent PMs next sprint. volunteers to review PR?

sabrina: i'll review.

omar: me too.

elaine: great 44d i'll post the one-pager in #incidents when the PR is up. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
